AVOID IF YOU ACTUALLY WANT TO KEEP YOUR MONEY Hidden fees will destroy your margins. I’ve used Invoice Simple for years with no issues when I was only creating invoices and getting paid by cash, check, or direct bank transfer. The app itself is fine for basic invoicing.
The moment I accepted my first payment through their built-in payment processing, everything went wrong.
A single $1,500 invoice ended up costing me almost $150 in fees and my customer was double-charged on their card too. I was hit with four separate charges on the same transaction (processing fee, service fee, “platform” fee, and some other mystery charge). That’s a 10% bite out of one job.
They advertise this as “small-business friendly” and “simple, low-cost payments,” but 10% on every transaction is absolutely predatory for freelancers, contractors, and small businesses who already run on thin margins. Stripe, Square, PayPal literally every other processor charges 2.9% + $0.30 or less. Invoice Simple is ripping people off and hiding it behind multiple stacked fees.
If you only need to create and email/pdf invoices that get paid outside the app, it’s okay. The second you turn on their payment processing, run away. There are dozens of better, truly affordable options that won’t punish you for getting paid.
Small business owners: do not make the same mistake I did. Look elsewhere for payment processing.
